ON THE 21 st OF JULY, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 28879 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 DINENDRA KEWAT S/O SHRI DASHRATH PRASAD  KEWAT, AGED ABOUT 24 YEARS, OCCUPATION:
 LABOUR R/O VILLAGE BHAGTA WARD NO 15, POLICE  STATION BIJURI DISTT. ANUPPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI ASHOK PALI - ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION BIJURI DISTRICT ANUPPUR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 .
 (BY SHRI ADITYA GUPTA - PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the C  the following:
 ORDER This is the repeat (second) bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No.238/2022 dated (not mentioned) registered at P.S. Bijuri, District Anuppur for the offence punishable under SectionS 376, 376 (2)(n) of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 04.01.2023.
His first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn.

As per prosecution, the prosecutrix has lodged a complaint that on the false pretext of marriage, the applicant has made physical relationship with her and when she got pregnant, he refused to marry her.
On the basis of such complaint, an FIR was registered against the applicant.
After the child was born, DNA sample was taken and as per the DNA report, the present applicant is the biological father of the child.
